[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant explained that political instability can limit government resources and discourage foreign investment, complicating efforts to stimulate the economy.

[USER] User asked about notable success stories of governments effectively stimulating their economies during instability.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided examples of success stories:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. South Korea: Implemented sweeping economic reforms after the Asian financial crisis, including corporate restructuring and increased transparency, leading to renewed economic growth.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Germany: After the 2008 financial crisis, Germany implemented tax cuts, infrastructure spending increases, and renewable energy subsidies, stabilizing the economy and fostering growth.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Australia: In response to the COVID-19 pandemic, Australia implemented wage subsidies, investment incentives, and direct payments to households, avoiding recession and experiencing economic rebound.
